description: Measurements filed by pm items, enforced as ratchets (pm-ips23h, pm-g4k74y, pm-5z9plz). Each declaration names the item that owns the property, a selector that recomputes it from tracked data, and the number that was filed. A ceiling fails when the observed value rises above it and guards a defect population; a floor fails when the observed value falls below it and guards a deliberately authored property. Exactly one polarity per declaration. A bound outlives its owner: the owning item tracks remediation and ends when the fix ships, while the property is a population over the record that does not end with it, so on_owner_terminal defaults to hold and the declaration keeps comparing after the owner closes or is canceled. Setting it to retire stops the comparison and requires a retired_reason naming why the property stopped mattering, so dropping a guard is a recorded decision rather than a side effect of closing a ticket. The floors below exist because every ceiling reads a mass deletion of typed relationships as an improvement, and --dep-remove deletes every row matching its selector.

declarations.note: Typed implements edges. This is the kind the strategic reachability invariant traverses: an active item resolves to an outcome milestone through implements, so this population is the outcome ladder's substrate rather than decoration. The total-edge floor cannot protect it, because converting implements rows to related rows leaves the edge count identical and every ceiling in this document unmoved, while silently flattening the ladder into an untyped mesh. Lower it deliberately here if a conversion is ever correct. Raised 2026-08-10 by the strategic-ladder wave: every capability and delivery-epoch epic now resolves to an outcome milestone through implements, and every parentless terminal item resolves to a capability epic, so apex-bypassing roots fell from 154 to 0 and items reaching no outcome fell from 1,024 to 11 recorded residuals. That layer is what this floor now protects; deleting it would restore the sibling-set topology pm-h6b73t was filed for.

Typed discovered_from edges: the derivation lineage recording which finding produced which item. It is the only kind that reconstructs how the record learned what it knows, it is written overwhelmingly onto terminal holders where no active-scoped check looks, and it is changelog-safe to author, which is exactly why it is easy to delete without anyone noticing. Guarded on the same terms as implements.

Typed verifies edges, the gate-to-product relation that records which mechanism proves which claim. The gate-versus-product split is a recurring filing pattern in this tracker and this edge is the only structural trace of it; without a floor, the relation degrades to related one row at a time and the record loses the ability to answer which guarantees are actually witnessed.

Typed supersedes edges: the only kind that records evolution, meaning which item replaced which as the project's understanding changed. pm-wmf72c was filed because this population was one edge across 1,799 closed items, so the record could not answer what superseded what across fourteen releases. It is now 71, of which 9 anchor duplicate-consolidation clusters recovered verbatim from consolidation comments and 8 join the v1 delivery epoch's canonical milestones to their archived PRD-numbered duplicates (pm-1w6scp). Every one of those was derived from durable recorded text, so none of them can be re-derived if deleted -- the consolidation comments would still exist but the reviewed direction would not. Guarded on the same terms as implements and discovered_from: a legitimate reduction must lower this number deliberately here.

Total deduplicated directed relationship edges. The typed graph is authored deliberately, pass after pass, and is the substrate every graph analytic and the strategic outcome ladder read. Nothing else in this document can notice it shrinking: every ceiling here falls when edges are removed, so before this floor existed a mass deletion improved the gate's verdict. Legitimate reductions do exist — retiring an alias kind or removing a genuinely wrong edge — and they must lower this number deliberately by editing it here, because --update only ever raises a floor. Raised 2026-08-10 after the strategic-ladder and parentless-lineage waves added 220 evidence-cited typed edges.

Total graph nodes, which tracks the item corpus including terminal items. The record is append-only by intent and items are closed rather than deleted, so this number only ever rises; a fall means items left the record, which is the one mutation no amount of history verification can reconstruct from the remaining streams.

blocks rows are resolved by pm graph but were invisible to the readiness resolver behind pm next, so an item gated only by a blocks row was classified ready. pm-jkbqt8 shipped corpus-aware reverse blocks resolution and closed on 2026-08-08, and a sandbox probe at this commit confirms a reverse blocks row now classifies its dependent as blocked. The hazard the original ceiling guarded is therefore gone, but the population is not: blocks remains a writable kind and grew from 241 to 243 while the bound was retiring. Held at its true current value so a regression in reverse resolution, or a pass that resumes authoring ordering in the invisible direction, fails before merge.

related_to is one of the alias spellings that canonicalize on read, so a graph-derived census cannot see it. pm-4020c5 shipped canonical registry-driven writes and closed on 2026-08-08; a sandbox probe at this commit confirms a related_to dependency is now stored as related, so this population is frozen legacy residue and can no longer grow through the supported surface. The seven rows that took it from 43 to 50 were written on 2026-08-08 before the write contract landed. Held rather than retired because holding a population that cannot grow costs nothing and is exactly what would catch a regression in the write-time canonicalization.
Active items unreachable from the relationship graph. Held at zero since the typed-connectivity work landed; this declaration keeps it there.
Active items reachable by at most one edge, which is the shape a spine-only lineage leaves behind. Held at zero; a new item filed without typed relationships fails here.
Two known pairs, each two genuine defects sharing one upstream issue code. The fix is check-side; neither pair may be renamed or merged. The ceiling stops a third pair appearing unnoticed.

Linked file paths that no longer exist, dominated by generated artifacts. The owning fix refuses such links at write time; until it lands the population may not grow. Re-baselined 195 -> 204 on 2026-08-05: 195 was measured against a maintainer working copy, where 9 links into the gitignored .agents/pm/extensions/pm-changelog install resolve. They resolve in no clone, so the population was always 204 and the gate now measures a commit view (pm-fr4dg8). The 9 excess links sit on legacy closed items whose closed_at is null, so removing them reorders the changelog until pm-wrbe lands; pm-j8z6 owns the burn-down back below 195.
A tracked path with no live owner remains in the linked-resource cleanup lineage and may not multiply.
Historical terminal items missing close reasons remain owned by the evidence-preserving metadata backfill and may only shrink.
Closed items missing the resolution triple. Every close from here on must carry it, so this ceiling only ever falls.
A pending local delivery queue remains an explicit observability limitation; an error status is a regression.

Exactly duplicated stored dependency rows. The class recurred: it was first reproduced on 2026-07-28, and three fresh rows were minted on 2026-08-05 by dep-appending mutations that do not deduplicate. Repair still requires removing every copy and re-adding one, so the workspace passes through a state where a real edge is absent. Held at zero so a re-appearance fails before merge rather than being found by the next reviewer.

Duplicated relationships between terminal endpoints. Informational because both endpoints are finished and no scheduler reads them; ratcheted so the terminal corpus cannot accumulate more while closed-item enrichment waves run.

Legacy no-active-blocker sentinel references predating typed dependency rows. Never repaired on terminal holders because rewriting closed items drags the changelog; ratcheted so no new sentinel can be authored.

Members of terminal-only execution-order cycles, summed across the eight reported groups. Every member is closed or canceled, so acyclic false is not a defect here; the ceiling stops a ninth group or a growing group from appearing unnoticed, which is the shape a reciprocal blocks and blocked_by pair produces.

Terminal dangling references to absent items. All three are pre-identifier sentinel strings rather than deleted items, so they are informational; ratcheted so a genuinely deleted item cannot add a fourth silently.
